description: Netz des öffentlichen Verkehrs is a dataset listed in Open Data Kanton Thurgau, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Kanton Thurgau, Abteilung Öffentlicher Verkehr. Beinhaltet Bushaltestellen und Bus-/ Bahnlinien und deren Berechnungsdistanzen und Fahrplanangebote sowie die Gebiete der Anrufsammeltaxis. Coverage: Canton of Thurgau. The portal files it under Transport. Its keywords are geodaten, eisenbahn, eisenbahnnetz, busbahnhof, pendeln, bahnhof. The portal shows 2026-07-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-tg-ch-portal.
